articles.title: Auditors Struggle to Catch Sabotage In End-to-End Transcripts of AI Safety Research
articles.description:
arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. articles.title: Honest Brokers in AI Regulation: How Public Comments Introduce Evidence to Regulators
articles.description:
arXiv:2611.21948v1 Announce Type: new

articles.title: DiscoveryAgent: A Framework for Scientist-centric Agentic AI
articles.description:

articles.title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
articles.description:
arXiv:2611.21799v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents.
